verified: the model manifest keeps bayespfl-general-v1 as the default and exposes only Bayes-PFL plus the steel and concrete specialists
factory-defect-guard-v6-mc remains registered for historical reproducibility but is hidden after its general-model rejection
tracked model-selection metadata records selected and rejected candidates and prevents a rejected registered model from being exposed
the Bayes-PFL deployment checkpoint remains train_visa.pth with VisA as the auxiliary training domain and MVTec AD as the distinct held-out qualification domain
Bayes-PFL category input is normalized to lowercase, accepts underscores for backward compatibility, and rejects malformed context before inference
the public model registry exposes curated category examples with local, upstream, and comparison evidence labels
Dashboard, Inspect, live stream, and Samples share model/category state without automatically switching the selected model
the operator showcase is defined as four MVTec AD good/bad pairs for bottle, capsule, screw, and metal nut from a pinned mirror revision
the rejected legacy general YOLO no longer contributes classes to the user-visible model registry or history filter
the model installer provides a manual artifact fallback with source, destination, expected size, SHA-256, and retry command when a download fails
historical runtime bundles remain immutable and are validated against their recorded source snapshots rather than rewritten to current source

known_limitations.detail: The latest retained CPU runtime record predates the current model-exposure, category-validation, selection-metadata, and probe-contract changes. It remains historical evidence until a fresh production-service probe is run and committed.

The current MVTec AD showcase does not redistribute dataset binaries in Git; sample image endpoints proxy a pinned MMAD mirror revision and therefore require network access when a sample image is opened.

Bayes-PFL localizes anomalies but emits the native generic type anomaly rather than a semantic defect subtype. Supported specialists remain preferable when semantic domain-specific classes are required.

The fixed 0.72 map threshold, component-area filter, and bbox padding are application adapter settings. Upstream evaluation does not provide a fixed deployment bbox threshold, so these settings are not an upstream accuracy claim.
The upstream Bayes-PFL repository states MIT licensing, but the distributed train_visa.pth checkpoint does not carry a separately stated binary license in the tracked source metadata.
Python API/detection/storage tests, frontend utility tests, validators, and a production build are present; full browser end-to-end automation is not part of the repository checks.
